SKIP_PATTERNS = [  
  
    r'^Diagram:', r'^AGDB Build Pipeline$', r'^Training Deployment Flow$',  
  
    r'^Inference Request Flow$', r'^Data Ingestion Pipeline$',  
  
    r'^Navigation:', r'^For detailed technical documentation.*sections',  
  
    r'^Frissítse ezt a wikit', r'kollarsandor/agdb', r'DeepWiki',  
  
    r'^Index your code', r'^Edit Wiki', r'^Loading\.\.\.',  
  
    r'^Utolsó indexelés', r'^Menü', r'^\d+$',  
  
    r'^System Architecture to Code Mapping$',  
  
    r'^Orchestration.*adatáramlás', r'^AGDB logika', r'^KVStore adatáramlás',  
  
    r'^WAL adatáramlás', r'FNDS Entity Mapping', r'^Rendszerbeli entitások',  
  
    r'^"FNDS Entity Mapping"',  
  
    r'^Architectural Integration$',  
  
]  
  
def should_skip(text):  
  
    for pat in SKIP_PATTERNS:  
  
        if re.search(pat]( text, re.IGNORECASE):  
  
            return True  
  
    return False  
  
def classify_line(line, prev_blank, next_blank):  
  
    stripped = line.strip()  
  
    if not stripped:  
  
        return ("blank", "")  
  
    if should_skip(stripped):  
  
        return ("skip", "")  
  
    if stripped.startswith("Title:"):  
  
        return ("heading2", stripped[6:].strip())  
  
    if stripped.startswith("| ---") or re.match(r'^\|[\s\-|:]+\|$', stripped):  
  
        return ("table_sep", stripped)  
  
    if stripped.startswith("|") and stripped.endswith("|") and "|" in stripped[1:-1]:  
  
        return ("table_row", stripped)  
  
    if re.match(r'^\d+\.$', stripped):  
  
        return ("skip", "")  
  
    if line.startswith(" ") and not line.startswith("  "):  
  
        if len(stripped) &lt; 130 and (prev_blank or next_blank):  
  
            return ("heading3", stripped)  
  
    if re.match(r'^\d+\.\s+\S', line):  
  
        return ("num_list", stripped)  
  
    if (line.startswith("   ") or line.startswith("\t")) and stripped:  
  
        if not stripped.startswith("|"):  
  
            return ("list_item", stripped)  
  
    return ("para", stripped)  
  
def translate_batch(texts, retries=3):  
  
    for attempt in range(retries):  
  
        try:  
  
            resp = requests.post(  
  
                DEEPL_URL,  
  
                headers=DEEPL_HEADERS,  
  
                json={"text": texts, "source_lang": "EN", "target_lang": "HU", "preserve_formatting": True},  
  
                timeout=90  
  
            )  
  
            resp.raise_for_status()  
  
            return [t["text"] for t in resp.json()["translations"]]  
  
        except Exception as e:  
  
            print(f"  Hiba ({attempt + 1}/{retries}): {e}")  
  
            if attempt &lt; retries - 1:  
  
                time.sleep(4)  
  
    return texts  
  
def run_translate():  
  
    with open("output.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:  
  
        raw_lines = f.read().splitlines()](  
  
    entries = []  
  
    for i, line in enumerate(raw_lines):  
  
        prev_blank = (i == 0 or not raw_lines[i - 1].strip())  
  
        next_blank = (i &gt;= len(raw_lines) - 1 or not raw_lines[i + 1].strip())  
  
        kind, text = classify_line(line, prev_blank, next_blank)  
  
        entries.append((kind, text))  
  
    to_translate = []  
  
    for i, (kind, text) in enumerate(entries):  
  
        if kind in ("heading2", "heading3", "para", "list_item", "num_list", "table_row") and text.strip():  
  
            to_translate.append((i, text))  
  
    BATCH_SIZE = 45  
  
    translations = {}  
  
    batches = [to_translate[i:i + BATCH_SIZE] for i in range(0, len(to_translate), BATCH_SIZE)]  
  
    print(f"Fordítandó egységek: {len(to_translate)}, batch-ek: {len(batches)}")  
  
    for b_idx, batch in enumerate(batches):  
  
        print(f"  Batch {b_idx + 1}/{len(batches)} ({len(batch)} elem)...")  
  
        indices = [item[0] for item in batch]  
  
        texts = [item[1] for item in batch]  
  
        translated = translate_batch(texts)  
  
        for idx, trans in zip(indices, translated):  
  
            translations[idx] = trans  
  
        time.sleep(0.25)  
  
    output_lines = []  
  
    prev_kind = "blank"  
  
    for i, (kind, text) in enumerate(entries):  
  
        if kind in ("skip", "blank"):  
  
            if kind == "blank" and prev_kind not in ("blank", "heading2", "heading3"):  
  
                output_lines.append("")  
  
            prev_kind = kind  
  
            continue  
  
        t = translations.get(i, text)  
  
        if kind == "heading2":  
  
            if output_lines and output_lines[-1] != "":  
  
                output_lines.append("")  
  
            output_lines.append(f"## {t}")  
  
            output_lines.append("")  
  
        elif kind == "heading3":  
  
            if output_lines and output_lines[-1] != "":  
  
                output_lines.append("")  
  
            output_lines.append(f"### {t}")  
  
            output_lines.append("")  
  
        elif kind == "para":  
  
            output_lines.append(t)  
  
            output_lines.append("")  
  
        elif kind == "list_item":  
  
            if prev_kind not in ("list_item", "num_list"):  
  
                pass  
  
            output_lines.append(f"- {t}")  
  
        elif kind == "num_list":  
  
            output_lines.append(t)  
  
        elif kind == "table_sep":  
  
            output_lines.append(text)  
  
        elif kind == "table_row":  
  
            output_lines.append(t)  
  
        prev_kind = kind  
  
    final = "\n".join(output_lines)  
  
    final = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', final)  
  
    final = final.strip()  
  
    with open("agdb_hu.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:  
  
        f.write(final)  
  
    print(f"\nKész! agdb_hu.md ({len(final)} karakter)")  
  
if **name** == "__main__":  
  
    print_status("=== 1. LÉPÉS: LETÖLTÉS ===")  
  
    run_fetch()  
  
    print_status("=== 2. LÉPÉS: TISZTÍTÁS ===")  
  
    run_clean()  
  
    print_status("=== 3. LÉPÉS: FORDÍTÁS ===")
